chunks: A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Ali ibn Asbat from Dawud from Ya’qub ibn Shu’ayb who said:

When the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) married Ali to Fatimah (peace be upon her), he entered upon her while she was weeping, so he asked her, 'What is making you weep? By Allah, if there were anyone better in my family than him, I would not have married you to him, and I did not marry you to him, but it is Allah who married you to him and gave you in marriage with the Khums (one-fifth) as long as the heavens and the earth exist.'
ai.seo_question: What was the mahr (dower) given to Fatimah (AS) during her marriage to Ali (AS) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the divine orchestration of the marriage between Imam Ali (AS) and Fatimah (AS), noting that while the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) facilitated the union, it was Allah who bestowed the unique mahr of 'Khums'. This attribution highlights the spiritual significance of the Progeny's marital bond, linking the material compensation to the broader theological concept of divine provision and the status of the Ahl al-Bayt.
